speaker: (the ostler)
text: Sixteen days, master, at twelvepence. And a girth-gall on the near side. That's extra, to my mind.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Sixteen days at twelvepence stands. The gall is the hire's own work. I'll not add a penny beside it.

speaker: (the ostler)
text: She's rubbed. You can see it. A gall is not in a twelvepence.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: She was hired, and she worked. The sixteen days are the charge. Nothing beside them.

speaker: (the ostler)
text: Have it your way. She's off your hands, gall and all.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Off my hands. Horse, fodder and inns, about eight-and-thirty shillings, and the sixteen sits inside that. I am not opening a new line for a rub.
